instructions.title: Your petition for contempt: before you file (do not file this page)
lines: This file has the Petition for Contempt (PO-0126) and the Order to Appear (PO-0128). ReadyFile filled in the heading of the Order to Appear. The court fills in the rest.
The petition must be based on what you saw or heard yourself. If someone else saw or heard it, attach a statement they signed under oath.
If you are in danger now, call 911. Breaking a protection order can also be reported to the police.
Sign and date the petition by hand. You sign under penalty of perjury.
Print 3 copies, unless the clerk tells you otherwise: one for the court, one for the other person, and one for you.
File both with the clerk of the court that issued the order.
This page is not part of your filing. Remove it before you file.
